coverageNotes: Measures table-specific ID validation, not existence checks, joins, cascade behavior or complete user/post construction.

questions.context: Using Convex SDK 1.44.0, `posts.author` must be a required document ID belonging to the `users` table. Reject arbitrary strings and IDs from other tables. Checking whether the referenced document still exists is handled separately. `v` is imported from `convex/values`.
questions.question: Which validator belongs on `author`?

options.rationale: A string validator also accepts arbitrary strings and IDs from posts.
v.id("users") validates table identity; a deleted users ID still has that identity.
This validates posts IDs and rejects users IDs.
This also accepts posts IDs, which the contract excludes.
